messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] RmaBackgroundCorrection
parts:
> Hi. In the documentation the following is suggested for rma background
> correction. I am getting the following error. Thank you. kv
>
>> bc <- RmaBackgroundCorrection(cs)
> Error: could not find function "RmaBackgroundCorrection"

The error is telling you that no function RmaBackgroundCorrection()
exists. This class is intended to be added to the package, but is not
there yet, so it seems the documentation is slightly ahead of the packahe
content in that respect.

Cheers,

Ken

messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] Re: RmaBackgroundCorrection
parts:
Hi,

for everyones information: some of the sections on the group page have
an asterisk in the section or page header, e.g. 'RMA background
correction*'. Mostly I have been using the asterisk to indicate that
this is "soon to come". From the "Home" page: "Please note: Sections
marked with an asterisk (*) indicate methods under development, and
may not be implemented in the current version.".

In this particular case, as Ken says, the "old" style function call
bgAdjustRma() is the way to do it for now, but when the
RmaBackgroundCorrection class is implemented that will be much more in
concordance with the rest of the API.

Cheers

Henrik

messages.author: 0e065001d5e74ca3
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] Re: RmaBackgroundCorrection
parts:
> Thanks. Does the result of bgAdjustRma() not require running 'process()'
> after that? kv

bgAdjustRma() directly returns an AffymetrixCelSet, so you do not need to
run process(). As Henrik said, this is "old style" and will be replaced
shortly.

Cheers,

Ken
